name: Dead Man's March

text.fail: A column of the dead files into the School and the Police Station, three at each.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Official name Dead Man's March (was our March of the Dead). English card photo (bing, tabletop-thailand): Tool or Fuel, 3 zombies at the school and 3 at the police station. Id kept for saves.
